AI ke servers par duniya ka saara data stored nahi hota. AI internet se information search aur retrieve kar sakta hai, lekin iska matlab yeh nahi ki uske paas har website, business ya coffee shop ka complete database already available hai.

Jab AI mein web search enabled hoti hai, toh woh search engines ke results aur publicly available online information retrieve karta hai, unka context samajhta hai, apni trained knowledge ke saath relevant information compare karta hai aur phir response generate karta hai. Har AI har baar Google hi use kare, yeh bhi zaroori nahi hai.

Example ke liye, agar hum poochte hain ki Africa mein sabse achhi coffee shop kaunsi hai, toh iska matlab yeh nahi hai ki AI ke servers par Africa ki saari coffee shops ka complete database ya unke private servers ka data stored hai. AI search results, public listings, reviews aur available information ke basis par relevant options identify karta hai.

Isi tarah data centres badhne ka reason bhi sirf users ki input information ko store karna nahi hai. AI models ko train karne aur unse responses generate karne ke liye massive computing power, GPUs, networking, electricity, cooling aur storage infrastructure ki zaroorat hoti hai. Users ke prompts aur files bhi service ki data-retention policy ke mutabik process ya store ho sakte hain, lekin yeh kehna ki har user input permanently store hota hai, technically correct nahi hai.
